description: WS2812B (classic) DIN input: input capacitance, VDD/GND clamp diodes, VIH/VIL thresholds relative to the pixel VDD.

clamps.note: No WS2812B datasheet specifies input clamps. ESD diodes to VDD and GND are assumed so the far end cannot ring to non-physical 7-8 V (design doc sec. 3). Overshoot/undershoot therefore depend on this assumption and are report-only.

vdd: tracks the driver corner rail (VCCB of the SN74LVC1T45 and the strip both hang off the channel's switched 5 V, chan_out); cable IR drop is not modelled

citations.what: VIH 0.7 VDD min, VIL 0.3 VDD max, input capacity CI 15 pF, input voltage -0.5..VDD+0.5 V, input current +-1 uA, VDD 4.5-5.5 V characterisation range, T0H 0.4 us +-150 ns
